summary: Grace Therapeutics filed an 8-K solely to announce an update to its corporate presentation on April 27, 2026. No material event, transaction, or special situation is disclosed—the filing is a routine current report attaching an updated investor presentation. There are no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes. The filing does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. Accordingly, this filing is not classified as a special situation.
